title: File
deleteBody: The file and its versions are removed from lists and the portal, and any review still waiting is canceled. An admin can restore it within 30 days before the storage is cleared.
archivedProject: This project is archived, so its files are read-only.
noVersions: This file has no stored version yet.
viewingOld: You’re looking at version {version}. The latest is version {latest}.

preview.caption: Version {version} · {size}
preview.pdfFallback: Your browser can’t show this PDF
preview.noPreview: No preview for this file type
preview.noPreviewHint: {type} · {size}. Download it to open it in an app.
preview.failedHint: The file may still be processing. Download it, or reload the page.
preview.quarantinedHint: Our file check flagged it, so it can’t be previewed or downloaded. Upload a new version.

upload.title: Upload a new version
upload.hint: This becomes version {version}. Earlier versions stay in the list, and any pending review reopens on the new version.

share.title: Client access
share.label: Share with client
share.onHint: Client contacts can open and download this file in the portal.
share.offHint: Only your team can see this file.
share.noClient: Link this project to a client to share files.
share.portalOff: The client portal is off for this project, so contacts can’t open it yet.
share.unsharedToast: No longer shared with the client

approvals.title: Approvals
approvals.empty: No reviews of this file yet.
approvals.emptyCan: Ask teammates or the client to approve this exact version.

edit.title: Edit file details
edit.description: The stored file doesn’t change; only how it’s listed.
edit.name: Name
edit.nameHint: Shown in lists and in the client portal.
edit.kindHint: Deliverables are work you hand over; they can be sent for approval.

browser.title: Files
browser.description: Everything uploaded across your projects: deliverables, attachments and their versions.
browser.noClientHint: This project has no client account, so files can’t be shared to a portal.
browser.emptyHint: Upload deliverables and attachments to a project, and they’ll show up here with their versions.
browser.emptyHintReadOnly: Files from projects you can open will appear here.
browser.emptyFilteredHint: Try a different search, project or file type.

storage.title: Storage
storage.detail: {count, plural, one {# stored version} other {# stored versions}}, counting every version of every file.
storage.note: Deleted files keep using storage until they’re cleared, 30 days after deletion.
